answer: In epoch 121, each identity holds one slot on a glacier front above an inlet: frontage is the scarce input, 2 kilometres of ice edge in 2-metre slots, one stake per slot. Surveyors on the knoll re-measure each stake weekly against the inlet gauge's flow model; daily positions are checkpointed in public. A track must advance inside the model's band; a hand-moved stake jumps off its track, and that jump voids the slot and its $120 bond. An honest agent pays $120 once; 1,000 fakes pay $120,000 and need the whole frontage. A fresh stake has no track, and past checkpoints cannot be backfilled.
